crossRefs.note: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not…
They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with…
When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.

translations.web: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
translations.bsb: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.
translations.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
